name: Project Scope Statement
purpose: Helps define and develop the project scope and the product scope. At minimum it holds the project scope description, the project deliverables, the product acceptance criteria and the project exclusions. It is developed once and is not usually updated unless the scope changes significantly.

elements.guidance: The project scope, progressively elaborated from the project description in the charter and from the requirements in the requirements documentation.
The deliverables, progressively elaborated from the key deliverables in the charter's project description.
Acceptance criteria elaborated from the information in the charter; they can be developed for each component of the project.
A clear statement of what is out of scope for the product and the project.

tailoring: For smaller projects, combine the project scope statement with the project charter.
For agile projects, combine the information with the release and iteration plan.
agile_or_adaptive: For agile projects the scope statement information can be combined with the release and iteration plan (Tailoring Tips, PDF page 56, printed page 45).
